verdict.rationale: ROCm is documented as AMD's GPU computing platform with a HIP runtime, compilers and libraries, optimized for AMD Instinct devices, and instinct.docs.amd.com covers the HIP C++ and OpenMP programming models. Community reports of production LLM serving on 8×MI355X show workloads do ship on this part. However, no evidence item shows ROCm documentation explicitly naming the MI355X (or its architecture target) as a supported target; support is shown only at the Instinct-family level. Missing for 10: an explicit ROCm compatibility-matrix or supported-GPU listing naming MI355X/CDNA 4, and first-party docs on compiling HIP for this specific target.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship GPU-compute workloads on the vendor's toolchain — CUDA or ROCm/HIP documentation lists this part as a supported target

citations.quote: It is open source, cross‑platform (Linux and Windows), and optimized for AMD Instinct™, AMD Radeon™, and AMD Ryzen™ AI devices.
ROCm is AMD’s open-source GPU computing platform: an end‑to‑end ecosystem of compilers, runtimes, and libraries for AI, HPC, and domain‑specific workloads.
